article.story: FORT WORTH, Texas -- — Jadyn Wooten had her first career triple-double with 18 points, 11 assists and 10 rebounds as No. 15 TCU rolled to a 96-48 victory over UT Arlington on Wednesday night. Wooten grabbed a rebound from Jalyn Brown's missed free-throw attempt with 2:57 left to finish the triple-double. It was TCU’s 51st straight win at Schollmaier Arena. The Horned Frogs play their next five games on the road before returning home to face UTSA on Dec. 10. Clara Silva added 16 points and 12 rebounds for TCU (7-0). Jessie-May Hall made three 3-pointers and scored all 15 her points in the first half for the Horned Frogs, who led 46-17 at the break. Lara Somfai finished with 12 points and Laura Vilcinskas had 11. The Horned Frogs entered the game with a nation-leading 138 assists. They had 24 against the Mavericks. Brown scored 17 points to lead UT Arlington (2-3). Up next UT Arlington: at Tennessee State on Sunday.
